Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: Misread the Discogs information and incorrectly inferred that “Written-By – Hank Williams” applied to “Turn Me On” (it applies to the other track, “Cold, Cold Heart”). This conflated the B-side credit with the A-side and contradicted reliable sources that credit John D. Loudermilk as the writer of “Turn Me On,” leading toward the wrong conclusion.
